$about: Hand-maintained corrections layered over the world-countries snapshot by
scripts/build-data.ts. This file is the source of truth wherever it and the
snapshot disagree (plan §3.2). Every section is keyed by entity id (slug).
Anything listed here appears in data-report.md, so the manual surface area
of the dataset is auditable in one place.
$statuses: Status where it cannot be derived from unMember/independent. Notably the snapshot marks Vatican City as a UN member, which is wrong — it is a permanent observer, and without this the UN-member count comes out at 194.
$sovereigns: Governing state for dependencies and territories. Entities absent from this map and not UN members are either disputed (Kosovo, Taiwan, Western Sahara, Palestine) or have no sovereign (Antarctica).
$altContinents: Transcontinental entities, reachable through more than one continent filter (§3.3). The primary continent stays as derived from the snapshot's region.
$capitals: Multi-capital entities and contested cases (§3.3). Replaces the snapshot's capital list wholesale. Exactly one entry carries isPrimary — that is the answer the quiz asks for; the others are accepted in expert mode and shown with their note in review.

sri-lanka.name: Colombo
sri-lanka.note: commercial capital and seat of government

western-sahara.name: El Aaiún
western-sahara.note: largest city; the territory is disputed

$extraAliases: Accepted alternative names beyond the snapshot's altSpellings, for expert-mode free text.
$squareFlags: Entities whose flag is officially square. These ship the flag-icons 1x1 asset rather than the 4x3 one, so the rendered flag is the correct shape (§3.3).
$confusableWith: Curated visually-confusable pairs, the top rung of the distractor ladder (§5.2). Symmetric — the build adds the reverse of every entry.
$tierOne: Familiarity tier 1 (§3.1): entities a casual player is expected to recognise. The build assigns tier 1 to these plus any UN member over 300,000 km²; tier 3 to dependencies, SARs and anything under 1,000 km²; tier 2 to the rest. This is an explicit heuristic, not sourced data.
$notes: Free-text explanations reproduced verbatim in data-report.md, so anyone reading the generated dataset can see why a value differs from the snapshot.

notes.vatican-city: The snapshot marks Vatican City as unMember: true. It is a UN permanent observer, not a member; corrected here, which brings the UN member count to the correct 193.
notes.hong-kong: The snapshot gives the capital as 'City of Victoria', a historic name rather than a current capital. Hong Kong is an SAR and has no capital, so the capital list is emptied — which excludes it from capitals and combo questions through the pool filter, not through a hard-coded exclusion (§3.3, locked decision 4).
notes.palestine: Ramallah is the de facto administrative seat and the primary answer; Jerusalem is listed as the declared capital and is accepted in expert mode. Inclusion is not a statement on sovereignty — see the About copy in Settings.
notes.western-sahara: Disputed territory. El Aaiún is the largest city and the answer used; the Sahrawi Republic administers from Tifariti. Alias 'Laayoune' accepted.
notes.kosovo: Uses the user-assigned ISO code XK, which is what flag-icons ships the flag under.
notes.eswatini: The snapshot lists only Lobamba. Mbabane is the administrative capital and the primary answer; both are accepted.
notes.sri-lanka: The snapshot lists only Colombo. Sri Jayawardenepura Kotte is the official capital and the primary answer; both are accepted.
notes.chile: §5.2 names 'Chile/Texas-alikes' as a confusable pair, but Texas is not an entity in this dataset. Paired with Cuba instead, which is the closest genuine confusable in scope.
